announcements.title: PhDRacket 0.1.2 Beta is available
announcements.body: Version 0.1.2 Beta adds file operations to the Explorer (new, rename, duplicate, cut, copy, paste, delete to the Recycle Bin, Properties), live updates when files change, hidden-file settings, and browser tabs to read an assignment page beside your code. To update, click the Update button in the status bar, or open About and choose Check for updates.
